topic: Promo carousel for the live video "The Longest Crypto Bear Market Ever - But What Happens Next Is Insane!"
body_style: watch-the-full-video link + headline + two arrow points + hashtags
body:
▶ Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/ewONo6zVER4

Is this the longest crypto bear market ever, or were there two?

→ $BTC is 415 days past its October 2025 top with no new high
→ By the rule, $BTC had two bear markets in just over a year

#Bitcoin #Crypto #BearMarket

images.slide_text: Side one: past them all / The last three took 406, 364 and 378 days top to bottom. This top was 415 days ago, with no new high.
Side two: the rule / Above the 50-week and 200-day averages means a bull market. By that rule, we just had one for a month and a half.
Why it hurt twice / Analysts point to two giant IPOs: SpaceX raised around 75 billion dollars, Anthropic around 81 billion. Rate fears hit too.
Bears end at a new high / It took 847, 1,080 and 1,127 days before. This one is at 415 and counting.
What I think / A short bear market ended in September and a new one began. Now is the time to buy assets, before a paycheck gets harder to get.
Watch the full video / The Longest Crypto Bear Market Ever
